notes.title: 🧜‍♀️ Mermaid Stage [Update: 8/1/2025]
notes.notes:
🎮 July Progress Report
Hi everyone!

I'm Saori UTSUMI, the jack-of-all-trades at Birdkin Studio, currently working on Curry Princess GOLD.

Thank you so much for your continued support!

Here’s a quick update on what we got done in July.


✅ Progress Highlights
Story Mode system is now 95% complete (+15% from last month)

Player state machine (refactored): 95% complete

Stage development: 4 out of X stages are now playable (1 more added this month)

This month, we added a few exciting features, including new vegetable items and appearances by rare monsters!
[hr][/hr]🎯 Goals & Progress
Our July goal was to finish the in-progress Mermaid Stage.

We’d say we’ve reached about 80% of that goal.

Here’s what’s still in progress:

Many of Lavender’s animations are still placeholders—we plan to replace them soon

There are still some bugs in the animated background we’re debugging

We wanted to make the bridge art more 3D-like, but that will have to wait until this month


August Goal:
Fully complete all 4 current stages, including effects and polish.

If we have the time and energy, we’ll also start prepping the event build ahead of schedule!
[hr][/hr]🖼️ Sneak Peek: Mermaid Stage in Development!
Here’s a screenshot from the Mermaid Stage we’ve been working on throughout July.

Note: This is a work-in-progress image and may change in the final version.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45349505/a354d4d1dd2fd4f0842aef0dcd20c0bf7dabb07f.png"]

Meet Lavender, the mermaid.

She’s a bit mysterious, and a singer-songwriter by trade.

Even the Curry Princess can’t help but be enchanted by her songs...

...and when Lavender notices the princess listening so intently, she’s a little surprised!
[hr][/hr]🌊 Final Note
That’s a wrap for our July update!

We’re steadily making progress, and still having fun with development.

Thanks as always for your support—please look forward to what’s next!

notes.title: Progress Update – July 2, 2025
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

I'm Saori UTSUMI, the general-purpose developer at Birdkin Studio, working on Curry Princess GOLD. Here's a quick update on our recent progress!
[hr][/hr]📝 Before We Dive In...
Last month, we applied to exhibit at OSAKA INDIE GAMES SUMMIT 2025 (#OIGS2025), a major indie game event held in Osaka. Please note that the event has a selection process, so applying doesn't guarantee participation — but if we're accepted, we'll definitely let you know here and on Twitter (X)!
[hr][/hr]🎮 Progress Report
Story Mode System: 80% complete

(Down 10% because we added new specs that we haven't started on yet)

Stages: Currently running 3 out of X stages

(Added and mostly finished 1 new stage)

Other areas: No major updates this month



What we've been working on:

Stage Polish:

Refined the visuals and finalized the algorithm for one of the in-progress Story Mode stages.

Enemy Class Refactoring:

Completely overhauled the base class controlling enemy algorithms to improve efficiency.

VFX & Feel:

Added satisfying effects when damaging enemies.

Accessibility Options:

Those effects can now be turned off via the Options menu.

Audio:

Continued composing music and creating sound effects as needed.



Our main focus in June was finalizing parts that were still placeholder-level, but some bugs still remain — it’s a work in progress.

For July, our goal is to fully complete the fourth stage we started back in April. We'd also like to refactor the save system and file access logic, not just add new content.
[hr][/hr]
Here’s a screenshot of the Dragon Stage we worked on in June. Please note that this is from a work-in-progress build and may change later.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45349505/73563d97ba394bdb76712905ae8bb9e7d03d6d0c.png"]

This dragon's name is Will, and he lives at the summit of Mount Alter. Curry Princess is energetic enough to climb even sky-high peaks surrounded by a sea of clouds!
[hr][/hr]
That’s all for now! We'll keep pushing forward with development — thank you so much for your continued support! Please look forward to what’s next!

notes.title: Development Update – June 2025
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

This is Saori UTSUMI, the all-rounder at Birdkin Studio, currently working on Curry Princess GOLD.
It's already June—time flies! Here's a quick update on our development progress:

---

🎮 Current Progress

- **Story Mode**: The four new stages created last month are now in the tuning and balancing phase.
- **How to Play Guide**: Content is about 90% complete, localization is at 40%, and image assets are at 10%.

Throughout May, we focused on debugging the event demo build and working on new stage designs.

---

🛠 How We Build a Stage

Here’s a general flow of how we create a new stage:

1. Start with a rough sketch and idea for the stage structure
2. Design the background and enemy visuals
3. Implement them into the stage
4. Estimate what animations and sound effects are needed
5. Create sound effects (realistic ones are handled by Hideaki)
6. Draw animations
7. Adjust enemy scripts
8. Break down enemy AI logic into tasks
9. Implement enemy behavior and attacks

Each stage also includes an intro scene and a clear scene, which we build as we go.

By the way, I'm personally handling all of the implementation work! Hideaki helps out with the sound effects I’m not so good at—especially the realistic ones—and that’s been a huge help.

---

That's it for now!

Thanks for following our development. We’re working hard to bring **Curry Princess GOLD** to life, so please stay tuned and keep supporting us!
